name: Light-Up Pulse Water Blaster — Shark
description: An electric pulse water blaster with continuous spray, automatic water intake and a light strip along the body. It has a simulated display screen and can connect to an outside water bottle. Water only. Don't aim at faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: Style code 917-1 (light version; headline on the photos reads "pulse electric light water gun"). Match made from the style-list thumbnails. Photos show only part of the blaster (close-up crops, soft after enlarging); no capacity, size or box contents are given for this style. Printed "WATER GUN" and a shark logo are on the body. Same 1688 offer (1089431913643) as the rest of the water-blaster range. MOQ unclear: the page says "1 Box starting batch" and lists carton counts of 12-48 pcs, so whether the price is per piece for a 1-piece order or needs a carton is unconfirmed. Prices are per piece from the style list. Store return rate not shown in the screenshots. China freight ¥4/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped toy: possible customs hold as an imitation firearm, owner to confirm with the clearing agent. Range is stated only on the 2309 box photo (8-10 m, seller figure) and used there; none is claimed for other models. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged).
